finding: This is the first study to identify reference ranges for thrombelastometry in preterm and term neonates immediately after birth and reports differences in clot initiation and clot strength in neonates born <37 versus ≤40 weeks of gestation, mirroring developmental hemostasis.
gest_age: preterm (30 + 0 to 36 + 6 weeks), term (37 + 0 to 39 + 6 weeks)
